title: Copilot Studio reaches the kb both ways
goal: Copilot Studio and other remote MCP clients can use the kb with one tool contract both ways: a host MCP server spawns kb_mcp.py over stdio (kb_mcp.py --roots, a contract test, kb/_self/embedding.md), and kb_http.py serves the same tools over stateless Streamable HTTP on loopback with Origin, bind and body guards and kb/public by default; a parity test proves both paths answer the same; kb/_self/hosting.md deploys the direct path on Azure Container Apps or App Service and on a VM as equals; and kb/public answers how Copilot Studio reaches and talks to a self-hosted MCP server.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?

notes: Own track, beside the Windows sprints: the operator started it while SP-z7a5c76b “Delivery proven” runs, and another machine works the Windows sprints and pushes to both remotes, so every landing goes through kbgit.py sync --push. It shares _tools/test_kb_mcp.py, kb/_self/plugin.md and kb/_self/tools.md with other sprints, so those items land one at a time. Its epic is EP-5sc7hr36 “Remote MCP clients use the kb directly and through a host MCP server”.
